cls: In macOS 14, Apple rebuilt menus for macOS using Cocoa. In macOS 13 and earlier, there’s only `-plugMenu:intoMenuRef:`, but in macOS 14+ there’s now also `-plugMenu:intoMenu:`. This CL only swizzles…
@mmentovai@chromium.org - Do you know if any Mac menus will break if this is introduced? (I can't think of any on my cursory check).
Move this into a separate test as it's testing something different.
Chromium doesn't use this key combo, so it's not clear what this is testing. Recommend choosing a different key combination.
Change to `ASSERT_TRUE`. If this check fails, there's no need to continue the test.
I don't believe Chromium has this behavior, so you'll want to use a different scenario to illustrate the point.
Excellent! I don’t know if we can rely on ElideText to elide in a grapheme-aware way, but I don’t think we should hold this CL to make sure of that.
